The package script verifies four rational examples; this is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact compatible-subset complex for the natural two-generator type-D parabolic configuration is a representable matroid, with sharp even-rank deletion threshold. This quantitatively explains why the direct rank-plus-two Helly witnesses used in symplectic and odd-orthogonal types cannot transfer, while leaving the unrestricted D_m gap explicit. Not a routine restatement of only the rank bound because it classifies each retained-line subset.
